metadata.description: Small sound-mode-v2 comparison of derived layer contracts and direct deployed-network verification
notes: This configuration is intentionally separate from the article experiment outputs.
Derived mode propagates per-neuron integer error budgets through hidden-layer contracts.
A vacuity sentinel is expected to return FAILED; that result demonstrates that the assumed input box has a witness.

This is a diagnostic sound-mode run, not a pre-certified example: an analytical margin failure triggers the exact output query and then one E2E fallback; unresolved queries end as MARGIN_INCONCLUSIVE.
The network-scope run verifies the deployed integer program directly and therefore does not use preimage contracts, chaining, or formal no-saturation harnesses.
Formal no-saturation is disabled here to isolate contract chaining and vacuity checks; deployed harness arithmetic still includes clamping.

runs.notes: Diagnostic run for derived budgets, enforced chaining, output-margin checking, and vacuity sentinels; certification is not assumed in advance.
